title: Fix ICP0 domain routing verification and prevent service worker interference

requirements.summary: Add IC domain verification file so boundary nodes can route genz-app.icp0.io correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: A new static file exists at `frontend/public/.well-known/ic-domains`.
The file contains `genz-app.icp0.io` on its own line (or in an accepted IC domain list format).

file_operations.description: Create the IC domain verification allowlist file and include `genz-app.icp0.io` on its own line so the boundary node can validate and route requests.

requirements.summary: Ensure service worker never breaks or reroutes requests to the .well-known IC domain verification file.
acceptanceCriteria: The service worker does not interfere with fetching `/.well-known/ic-domains` (it should succeed even on first load and after refresh).
No redirect loop or offline fallback is triggered for `/.well-known/ic-domains` when the network is available.

file_operations.description: Update the fetch handler to explicitly bypass caching and offline fallbacks for requests under `/.well-known/` (including `/.well-known/ic-domains`), ensuring they are served from the network (or pass through untouched) and never trigger navigation fallback behavior.

requirements.summary: Add a public troubleshooting/help section on the unauthenticated Landing page for “Canister ID Not Resolved” errors.
acceptanceCriteria: The Landing page contains a clearly titled section (e.g., “Troubleshooting Access Issues”).
The section explicitly includes the exact URL `https://genz-app.icp0.io` in visible text.
The section instructs users to delete old bookmarks/home-screen shortcuts and reopen the correct URL.

file_operations.description: Add an English-only, clearly titled troubleshooting/help section to the unauthenticated landing page explaining what to do if the user sees “Canister ID Not Resolved”, explicitly showing `https://genz-app.icp0.io` and instructing users to remove old bookmarks/home-screen shortcuts and retry.
